name: walle architecture topology
scope: Facts used by .spec Mermaid diagrams. Keep this small; detailed contracts live in .spec/*.md.

nodes.cli: cmd/walle: root command, daemon command, ps, attach, default TUI start
nodes.daemon: walle daemon: user-level supervisor for interactive Runtime processes
nodes.interactive_registry: daemon-owned registry of workspace interactive Runtime processes
nodes.daemon_session: internal/runtime.DaemonSession: adapter for one interactive Runtime and its event history
nodes.agentd: internal/agentd.Agentd: generic process table and scheduler
nodes.runtime: internal/runtime: composition root; one instance per interactive process or generic process runner
nodes.agent: internal/agent: ReAct loop and tool execution
nodes.tools: internal/tools.Registry: base, skill, context and optional MCP tools

implemented_edges: spawn if supervisor socket is missing
create or attach workspace interactive processes
write generic process reports and worklogs
entry_invariants: default walle creates a new interactive Runtime for the current workspace
walle -c / --continue is the only default-entry mode that may continue the latest workspace Runtime or latest session
walle attach <id> attaches an existing process and never creates a Runtime
daemon is a supervisor and must not be modeled as one fixed interactive Runtime
optional_or_planned: mcp.<server>.<tool> only appears after explicit MCP connection and RegisterMCPTools
terminal.<name>.<action> dynamic tools are planned in .TODO/10_动态终端工具.md
LM Projection mask/unmask/unpin is planned in .TODO/11_上下文掩盖与LLM投影.md
forbidden: no fixed TaskList, /task, task watcher, or .walle/task.md source of truth
internal/agentd must not import Runtime or task/business packages
TUI must not hold Runtime or Agent pointers in attached mode
default walle must not silently attach the last interactive Runtime
